reason: Free listing costs me nothing and they load the flyers themselves, so I'd let them, but I won't pay for anything until I see real users in my city. My Instagram and the PR guys' lists already fill the room.
objection: How many people actually use this app here? A new app with no audience in my area doesn't bring me a single extra person on a Saturday.
would_change_my_mind: Published numbers showing well over 2,000 monthly active users in my city, and proof that other clubs near me got real people through the door from it.
